description: Stormwater Infrastructure as a Socio-Ecological System: The Case of Aaran's Pond is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brooke Page, University of South Florida (usf.edu). This poster examines stormwater ponds as complex adaptive ecosystems in the urban environment, in which community residents and other stakeholders are integral components. Stormwater ponds are important forms of green infrastructure used to control flooding in the Tampa Bay area. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-s868-kp55. Keywords: Flood, Community, Environmental justive. Published 2025-08-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
